label: Oxidative stress
notes: Reactive oxygen species imbalance contributing to skin aging.

label: Matrix metalloproteinase activity
notes: Increased activity of collagen-degrading matrix metalloproteinases.

label: Collagen degradation
notes: Loss and fragmentation of dermal collagen.

label: Elastic fiber damage
notes: Damage or abnormal remodeling of dermal elastic fibers.

label: UV-induced DNA damage
notes: DNA photodamage caused by ultraviolet exposure.

label: Pigmentation dysregulation
notes: Irregular regulation or distribution of skin pigmentation.

label: Skin barrier impairment
notes: Reduced epidermal permeability-barrier function or recovery.
